say:2:1029112001:1.text: May Dura protect you. How can I help?
say:2:1029112001:1.source_cn: 愿女神庇佑您。诸位有什么事吗？

say:3:1029112002:1.text: Esteemed acolyte, we'd like to ask about a very serious matter. Have you seen an odd little girl around here?
say:3:1029112002:1.source_cn: 修士大人，我们想要和你打听一件重要的事……你有没有在这...

say:4:1029112003:1.text: Oh! You mean the girl who keeps talking about "Syriosus", "the abyss", "kin", and all that weird stuff?
say:4:1029112003:1.source_cn: 胡言乱语……啊！那个一直说什么“赛利欧斯”“深渊”“眷...

choice_prompt:5:1029112003.text: Oh! You mean the girl who keeps talking about "Syriosus", "the abyss", "kin", and all that weird stuff?
choice_prompt:5:1029112003.source_cn: 胡言乱语……啊！那个一直说什么“赛利欧斯”“深渊”“眷属”之类奇怪词汇的小女孩吗？

say:6:1029112004:1.text: She was here not long ago. She may have been mumbling words of evil, but I didn't sense any strange aura.
say:6:1029112004:1.source_cn: 就在不久之前，她出现在了这里。虽然口中念念有词着邪恶的...

say:7:1029112005:1.text: When I tried to exorcise her, she yelled something like "Impudence" and "Stand down", then ran off...
say:7:1029112005:1.source_cn: 当我试图给她驱魔时，她喊着什么“放肆”“退下”之类的话...

say:8:1029112006:1.text: I can just imagine Dora saying that... Do you remember in which direction she ran?
say:8:1029112006:1.source_cn: 感觉耳边已经能听到朵拉说这些话的声音了……那你还记得她...

say:9:1029112007:1.source_cn: 她应该是去了西边的方向。

say:10:1029112008:1.text: Thank you, esteemed acolyte! Let's head west, Magister!
say:10:1029112008:1.source_cn: 谢谢你，修士大人！主人，我们去西边看看吧！
say:10:1029112008:1.male: Thank you, esteemed acolyte! Let's head west, Magister!
say:10:1029112008:1.female: Thank you, esteemed acolyte! Let's head west, Magister!
